Delete Prov Url
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/provUrl/:id

Deletes the provisioning template specified by the provisioning template ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
int32
REQUIRED

ID of the provisioning template.

Responses
